rv.q: Fortunately, “The Visit” does speak clearly in Tresnjak’s production, beautifully arrayed on scenic designer Alexander Dodge’s inventive simulacrum of the town.
And with lead performances like Mays' and Hamilton's, the production is — sorry to do this here — worth your visit.
The Visit is an absorbing and timely indictment of that oxymoron called humanity.
With the ambitiousness of its programming, and the quality of its productions, Pasadena Playhouse is on a streak.

cn.t: Critics praise this visually stunning revival of Dürrenmatt's dark morality play, with the "Amadeus" team of director Darko Tresnjak and star Jefferson Mays delivering another absorbing, darkly comic examination of human cruelty and moral corruption.
